If the pool needs help now, call (520) 372-1083 and the line will connect you with an independent pool service company in the Tucson area.

Skip the search and call

It is one free call, day or night. Tell the assistant what the pool is doing and which part of the Tucson area it is in, and you are transferred to a local, independently owned pool company that looks at the pool in person and names its own price.

Call (520) 372-1083

  • Around the clockNights, weekends and holidays, every call gets an automated answer.
  • Free to callThe line never sends you a bill. Prices come only from the pool company.
  • Check the ROC numberBefore any repair or equipment job, get the company's state contractor number and search it on the ROC website.
  • Your call to makeListen to what the company found and what it will cost, then decide whether to hire it.

Tucson Pool Cleaning Pro is a free phone line, not a pool company. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local pool service company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly. Companies may pay a referral fee. The line never charges you.
